title: AIstock MCP server URL path identifier injection - httpx normalizes ../ allowing escape from /api/v1/validation
description: scripts/aistock_mcp_server.py interpolates path identifiers directly into URL paths (get_plan f'/plans/{plan_key}', get_validation_run, get_bug_agent_context, get_validation_execution_status/log). httpx normalizes ../ segments, so a caller can escape /api/v1/validation and issue same-host GETs outside the intended Validation Center subset. Security risk if any caller is untrusted. Codex REV-5 P1.1 finding (drawer ac034eef + 6bdc47eb). Fixed in pipeline Stage 4+5 fix round 1 (commit c7441ba) by adding _sanitize_identifier with regex ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$ to all 5 path-interpolating tools, blocking /, ?, #, %, whitespace. Plus 14 path-traversal regression tests + 4 canonical-id accept tests.
required_verification: Codex independent re-review of pipeline Stage 4+5 fix round 1 on origin/claude/pipeline-foundation-20260510
closure_requirements: Codex round-2 review pass on pipeline Stage 4+5 fix round 1
MCP server activated in production-like config without bypass
